title: CLASH: Counterfactual Auditing of Lexical and Prosodic Reliance in Spoken Sarcasm Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.16582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spoken sarcasm detectors may exploit lexical content, prosody, or their interaction, yet conventional evaluation cannot reveal which cues drive their predictions. We introduce CLASH (Controlled Lexical-Acoustic Separation Harness), a bilingual counterfactual diagnostic framework that evaluates each utterance under original, lexical-preserving, prosody-preserving, and approximately neutralised conditions. We evaluate handcrafted acoustic-feature systems, self-supervised learning (SSL) probes, and large audio language models (LALMs) on CMMA and MUStARD. For target-only Qwen3-Omni, lexical-preserving speech retains a 0.135--0.148 AUROC advantage over prosody-preserving speech after duration balancing, with cluster-bootstrap intervals above zero; alternative lexical resynthesis preserves this advantage. Acoustic interventions shift scores without consistently improving discrimination or changing binary predictions under the evaluated condi

translated_title: CLASH：口语讽刺检测中词汇与韵律依赖性的反事实审计
translated_abstract: 口语讽刺检测器可能利用词汇内容、韵律特征或两者的交互作用，然而传统的评估方法无法揭示究竟是哪些线索驱动了模型的预测。我们提出了CLASH（受控词汇-声学分离框架），这是一个双语反事实诊断框架，可在原始条件、词汇保留条件、韵律保留条件以及近似中性化条件下对每条话语进行评估。我们在CMMA和MUStARD数据集上评估了手工设计的声学特征系统、自监督学习（SSL）探针以及大型音频语言模型（LALM）。对于仅使用目标话语的Qwen3-Omni，在经过时长平衡后，词汇保留语音相比韵律保留语音保持0.135至0.148的AUROC优势，且其聚类自助法置信区间高于零；采用替代性词汇重合成方式也保持了这一优势。声学干预虽然会改变模型得分，但在所评估的条件下并未持续提升判别性能或改变二分类预测结果。
tldr: 该论文提出CLASH双语反事实诊断框架，通过分别保留词汇或韵律信息的受控干预来审计口语讽刺检测模型的线索依赖性，发现以Qwen3-Omni为代表的大型音频语言模型主要依赖词汇内容而非韵律来进行讽刺判断。
en_tdlr: CLASH is a bilingual counterfactual diagnostic framework that audits lexical versus prosodic reliance in spoken sarcasm detectors, revealing that large audio language models such as Qwen3-Omni predominantly exploit lexical content over prosody.
